subject.name: Preschool and Childcare Center Directors
subject.summary: Preschool and childcare center directors plan and coordinate the educational and non-educational activities of preschool or childcare programs, arranging staffing, resources, parent communication, and center operations. O*NET 11-9031.00 covers childcare centers and before- and after-school programs; individual directors may also teach or provide direct care, but management duties are not the same as classroom teacher duties. Staffing, pickup and drop-off, privacy, and safety follow local regulations and center policy.
